question: Ticket cffb99063d09 says "host tool lives under cairn/devices/system_rackmount/tools/host/ and is used by every other component's host sites (siblings under a577fd03e307)", but outline 17.26 reads "Where a tool lives: the general collection, cairn/tools/, is the default. A tool goes with its holder (cairn/devices/<d>/tools/) only when nothing else could ever use it (a tool for a part only that one device has). If there is any chance somebody else might want it, it goes in the general collection." (Outline 17.26 specifies that a tool goes under cairn/devices/<d>/tools/ only when 'nothing else could ever use it.' Since the ticket explicitly shows multiple components using this tool, that condition is false. The tool should reside in cairn/tools/ per the outline's default location rule). Which stands, the ticket or the outline?
why_it_blocks: the ticket and the component outline disagree; building it would build one of them wrong
answer: The outline stands, and the ticket agrees with it. Outline 17.26.1 (landed on main at c8224d38a): a client tool a device publishes (2.3.7.1) is the device's own interface, made for other components to use, so it lives with its device. CC's decision from 2.3.7.1 and Akien's ruling 'hostname should come from the system device' (2026-11-21). All four tools that already declare published_by_device live under their own device and are used by other components: cairn/devices/cairn/tools/scratch_bus, db_domain/tools/client, trouble/tools/store, librarian/tools/trees. 17.26's general-collection default covers tools a device does not publish.
